title: 查看全部动态 opens an unsorted system audit list: no time order, metadata and login rows mixed in, and a developer sentence as its description
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「缺陷 2-7 立卡」 (2026-11-04).

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a browser evaluation of the Console on `main` `63b86b385d` (example CRM, zh-CN, dev admin). An independent reviewer ran the pass and the seat re-checked the evidence named below. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

The home page's 活动动态 panel shows what happened to the business, and its 查看全部动态 link promises more of the same. It opens a raw table instead. A manager asking "what happened today" sees rows out of time order, with 更新了 系统元数据 and 更新了 用户：最近登录时间 between the sales events. The page title is also 活动, the same word as the CRM's own 活动 (calls and meetings).

## Reproduce

Home → 查看全部动态, which opens `/apps/com.example.crm/sys_activity`.

Seen on the reviewer's screenshot, which the seat read: header 活动 / 所有记录 · 70 · 只读 · 审计日志, description 最近活动流条目（轻量、去规范化）. The 时间戳 column runs 下午4:34, 4:40, 4:36, 4:44, 4:35, 4:38. Rows include 创建了 元数据历史, 更新了 系统元数据, 创建了 数据迁移 pinyin-search-companion and 更新了 用户 "Dev Admin"：最近登录时间, between business rows.

## Code readings on `63b86b385d`

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx:893` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx:292`: both doors go to the plain object route.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts:21,35`: label `Activity`, description `Recent activity stream entries (lightweight, denormalized)`; the zh-CN bundle translates that sentence literally.

The list was read as a platform admin. What a member without admin rights sees is not measured, and the card should measure it.

## Acceptance

1. The page opened from these doors shows newest first by default.
2. Rows about platform internals (metadata history and drafts, migrations, a user's login stamps) are not in that default page. The rows stay available to an administrator on the audit surface.
3. The description a reader sees says what the page is, in plain words.
4. The page's title does not collide with an app's own 活动. The wording is the implementer's to propose on the PR.
5. A browser check as an admin and as a member.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "lightweight, denormalized" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts`
